# Public constants contract (cms-api)

<!-- module-flows:start (generated by .claude/bin/module-index; do not edit) -->

Flows: none yet.

<!-- module-flows:end -->

## Purpose

Collects the constants the frontends must agree with (error codes, limits, enums of the access, backups, content-engine, identity, media and reviewer modules) into one generated file, and checks it is current.

## Techniques

Pure builder (`buildPublicConstants`) + renderer; a CLI command writes the file or, with `--check`, fails when it differs. Frontend contract tests compare their copies against it.

## Technologies

Node.js (`node:fs/promises`, `node:path`, `node:util`), TypeScript.

## Entry points

`pnpm --filter @abyss/cms-api contract:print` (`-- --check` in CI).

## Where to change what

A new shared constant: export it from its module's `index.ts`, add it in `PublicConstants.contract.ts`, run `contract:print`, update the frontend copy and its contract test.
